description: The mechanism: the gearless PMSM traction machine on its bedplate on the rail tops (dual-circuit brake), the full 2:1 suspension (4 ropes per run as sliding tube runs, wraps on every sheave, diagonal under-car run, hitches with wedge sockets, springs and load sensor), the detailed car (sling, platform, diagonal underslung pulleys, roller guides, progressive safety gear and linkage, cab with the near panel cut away, COP, centre-opening car doors with operator, coupler and light curtain, car-top inspection station and balustrade, apron), and the counterweight (frame, filler weights, pulley, shoes, striker). The sheaves turn from the model's angles. It replaces the FEAT-001 placeholders. Depends on FEAT-001. Design source: plan.md sections 3, 4 (items 29-98), 5, 6.
steps: Read context.json and this file, then plan.md sections 3-6. Read FEAT-001 findings for anything the scaffold changed (helper names, layout constants).

parts\machine.mjs (items 29-43): bedplate (two channels + cross plates, weld seams via k.sideSeam as inner) on the y1 car-rail top (x=100) and CWT-rail-1 top (x=80) at 1530..1534 with isolation pads and a tie bracket to the x0 wall; motor housing Ø40 coaxial with T (axis x, x 40..72) via G.solidOf with smooth rounded rims; cooling ribs with G.ribsOf(..., { seams: true, fade }) + k.fadedSvg; traction sheave T (lit) at (80,159,1556), R 16, x 74..86, profile with 4 groove steps at x 78.2/79.4/80.6/81.8; outboard bearing bracket; two independent brake units and the brake disc; encoder; terminal box; rope retainer bar. T's +x face gets a face-plane group (planeMatrix) with spokes ending on the hub and rim rings and a lit index mark, inside <g data-rot="T">.

parts\ropes.mjs (items 44-56): hitch A (bracket on the y0 wall over (120,14), plate, load-weighing sensor) and hitch B (plate under the overhead hitch beam over (80,207)); 8 hitch rods with compression springs (G.ribsOf helix with twist, drawn after the rod), nuts and wedge sockets. Four rope runs x 4 ropes as H.ropeSlide: hitch A socket → S_far tangent (ride travel, move car), S_near tangent → T tangent at y 143 (move car), T tangent at y 175 → C tangent (move CWT), C out-run at y 207 → hitch B socket (move CWT). Each rope k sits at its groove offset; the bottom lands on its pulley's groove tangent at rest. Wraps: tube arcs from G.arcPoints on T (static), S_near/S_far (ride car), C (ride CWT). The under-car diagonal run x 4 is a tube route (ride car). Use the 'bundle' meta so parallel ropes may lie side by side.

parts\car.mjs (items 57-92): sling uprights at x=100 on both sides, crosshead, plank, platform; the diagonal pulley beam under the platform (G.prismOf along d-hat) carrying S_far (115.3,29.3) and S_near (84.7,127.7) at Lf-42 with axis (0.955,0.296,0), face groups data-rot="Snear"/"Sfar"; 4 roller guides, each split into base plate, the two face rollers and a tip roller as separate items around the rail blade; 2 progressive safety gears (wedge housings around the blades, split like the rollers) and the synchronising rod; the governor-rope lever with its rope clamp reaching x=113, y=146; the cab (back wall + handrail, far side wall y0 with panel seams and the COP: 5 buttons with data-car-call="1..5", a display window, door-open/close and alarm buttons, all in face planes; corner posts; ceiling with a light panel; floor finish; the near y1 panel cut away); car door panels x2 in <g data-door="car-l|car-r"> inner groups; door header, track and hangers; door operator (motor, belt, pulleys, box) on the car top; coupler vane; light-curtain strips; car sill and apron to Lf-75; car-top inspection station, balustrade on the y1 roof edge, junction box, limit-switch cam, positioning reader head. Every car item: piece 'car' (or its own group id), ride 'travel', move [0,0,1120].

parts\cwt.mjs (items 93-98): CWT frame (uprights + top/bottom channels) with plan {x:72,y:168,w:16,d:46}, 280 tall, bottom 1200 at rest; 8 filler weights as separate slabs with seams; retainer bar; pulley C on the top at (80,191) with its face group data-rot="C"; 4 guide shoes split around CWT rails 1 and 2; buffer striker plate. ride 'travel', move [0,0,-1120].

Remove the FEAT-001 placeholders. Update info.mjs with groups machine, brake, sheave, ropes, hitches, car, sling, guides, safety, cab, doors, cartop, cwt (names and one true sentence each, numbers from SPEC).

live.js: rotate each data-rot group from derived() angles (T: sheaveAngle, Snear/Sfar: carPulleyAngle, C: cwtPulleyAngle), with the sign per sheave chosen so the rim moves with its rope (car rising ⇒ the car-side rope at T goes up). Call k.holdStill on every rope-slide node with that node's screen offset. Keep the per-frame re-sort.
Run the audit and fix every failing line in the geometry (reroute, split, gap or seat). Never bias a key and never record stand-in shapes. Keep a CROWD_OK list only for pairs inspected at 8x.

Shoot the 4x close-ups listed in plan.md section 10 for the mechanism (machine and brake, hitch A and B, T wraps, C on the CWT, under-car pulleys, a roller guide and the safety gear) in both themes and read them. Do a slowed sheet to confirm sheave rotation direction and smoothness.
acceptance_criteria: node build.mjs --light --audit ends with 'audit passed' (clearance, through in mid-flight, terminals, support, depth order, crowding, stand-in shapes, folds, self-overlap, wobble all 0).
lines.mjs prints 'line ends: 0' on both mrl-elevator-light.html and mrl-elevator.html.
During a run, the traction sheave index mark turns visibly faster than the car pulleys, and the CWT moves opposite to the car in a motion capture.
Every vertical rope run stays attached at its fixed end and lands on its pulley at rest, mid-travel and at L5 in screenshots.

findings:
Done inside the FEAT-003 step (no separate FEAT-002 run). FILES: new parts/machine.mjs (exports faceMarks(H,hub,rim,spokes,{id,tone}) and circle(); only T's index mark is tone 'lit'), parts/ropes.mjs, parts/car.mjs (build(H,L,{open})), parts/cwt.mjs; edited build.mjs, layout.mjs, lib/helpers.mjs (box() takes wrap(svg) and owner; ropeSlide uses spacing 20), live.js, mrl.css, info.mjs, parts/rails.mjs, parts/shaft.mjs; deleted parts/placeholders.mjs.

DESIGN CHANGES vs plan (audit-driven): rope pitch 2.0 (offsets -3,-1,1,3 along each sheave axis, L.ROPE) so hitches fit; car-side runs rise exactly vertically from the S_near grooves to L.T_LEAD_Z = 1540, then a short lead in the T wrap; T, C, S_near/S_far are split into body + near-flange items (near flange carries the data-rot face); the S pulleys' near flange is r 16.6; rails are drawn as separate foot and blade boxes (guides sit in the notch); back walls are cast in storey lifts (pour joints at slab soffits) so the audit doesn't treat them as slender rods; the roof stub and the overhead hitch beam are NOT built (they hid the machine): hitch B is a plate on top of CWT rail 2 (raised to 1560); car buffers moved to (60,40) and (140,118) clear of the under-car diagonal. T wraps and the other merge joints use route ends:[false,false] plus touch on the sheave and the continuing slides. CROWD_OK = [[ropes.wrapC*, ropes.B*], [ropes.wrapT*, ropes.cwt*]] (four ropes of one run side by side, inspected at 4x).

IDS: data-rot = T, Snear, Sfar, C (and gov from FEAT-003), rotated in live.js SPIN: T -sheaveAngle, Snear/Sfar +carPulleyAngle, C +cwtPulleyAngle, gov +govAngle (degrees, inside the face-plane groups). COP: data-car-call=1..5, data-door-open, data-door-close, data-alarm (role=button, aria-label), text[data-car-display]. Car door panels and hangers/vane in <g data-door="car-l|car-r">, slide 39.5 cm (L.DOOR.slide; left panel -y, right +y). Groups: machine, brake, sheave, ropes, hitches, sling, guides, safety, cab, doors, cartop, cwt (+ limits/tape on car cam and reader).

CHECKS: audit (light) passed: 18 tubes · 620 solids · 868 items · 57 depth states · 265131 overlaps · 78 s, all lines 0. lines.mjs light/dark: 0. Close-up shots/z-machine-light.png and z-run-machine-*.png: T wraps, C on the CWT, governor turning, ropes attached at fixed ends while the CWT descends.
